statement: Flag a rest-day target more than 25% below maintenance, or below BMR.

quotes: up to 1.5%/week and 30–50% deficit at higher body-fat levels
bu.note: BU allows deficits of 30–50% at higher body fat (and up to 30% early in a lean prep). The 25% safety cap is stricter. That may be intended as a safety margin, but BU does not state it.

statement: Flag standard exercises that load a reported injury site, plus the client's own avoid list.
moduleRef: BU: Training around tendon injuries & joint pain

bu.section: Module: Training around tendon injuries & joint pain — keeping hypertrophy productivity high
bu.note: This module covers training around injuries. The conflict detection has not been checked against it yet.

statement: Flag under 6 hours of sleep: it can limit recovery and progress.

quotes: 4 nights of 4-7 hours of sleep (vs. 8) raises appetite by 20-22%
bu.note: BU puts the harm below about 7 hours, compared with 8. The 6-hour flag is looser.
